downloaded_song_ids = {song['song_id']: song['duration'] for song in downloaded}

    total = sum(downloaded_song_ids.get(sid, 0) for sid in song_ids)
    album_totals[album_id] = total
    print(f"Album {album_id}: total downloaded duration = {total} sec")
